name: Troika Consulting
deliverable: Rapid triad peer consulting using back-turned active listening protocols

steps.text: Form triads and assign one client and two consultants; run three ten-minute rounds so each person takes every role.
Give the client two minutes to state the challenge, what has been tried, and where they are stuck; consultants listen only.
Allow two minutes of clarifying questions about facts and constraints, then stop all advice until the next beat.
Have the client turn away or mute while the consultants talk to each other for five minutes about the real problem.
Turn the client back for one minute to name what was useful and the single next step they will try.

failure: The client keeps turning around to defend decisions, so the consultants start managing the client's reaction instead of exploring the problem.
intervention: Say to the client: "Turn back and stay silent. Every word you add narrows what they will say; your minute to respond is coming."
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
